stemMd: A writer describes how museum conservators document a fragile map before treatment. Which detail best supports the importance of documentation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The map depicts a coastal region.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The museum shop sells postcards of a different map.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Photographs preserve a record of tiny tears that might become difficult to locate after repairs.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Most staff members commute by train.

explanationMd: The task asks why documenting the condition matters. A photographic record of tears allows later comparisons and preserves information that repair may obscure.

distractorRationale.d: Commuting does not develop the preservation procedure.
distractorRationale.a: Its subject alone does not explain why documenting its condition matters.
distractorRationale.b: Shop inventory does not explain documentation before treatment.
